notes: Half-buried square stone temple, about 6.0 x 6.9 m and 2.6 m to the cornice top (scale bar about 72 px/m). It has stepped corbels under a projecting roof slab, two string courses, a small 0.68 x 1.3 m doorway, and a square well-opening in the roof at the back right. A fig tree grows from the roof's front-left corner (crown to about 4.15 m) and hangs its roots down the facade. Sand drifts bank about 1.95 m high against the back wall and taper toward the front along both sides, all on an 8 x 8.7 m sand pad. The middle 'Side' view is the +x side (front on the left); the lower 'Side' view is the -x side. The top view and the side views disagree slightly on depth, so the depth is a compromise.
